name: deadweight
description: Find and remove unused dependencies, stale .env keys, and dead tsconfig paths.

deadweight.ignore.markdownDescription: Names Deadweight should never flag: `.env` keys, dependency names, or tsconfig path aliases and targets. `*` matches any characters, e.g. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`. You can also silence a single line in a `.env` or tsconfig file with a `# deadweight-ignore` / `// deadweight-ignore` comment at the end of it or on the line above.

deadweight.checkDevDependencies.markdownDescription: Also check `devDependencies` in `package.json`. Off by default: dev tools are often used in ways Deadweight can't see (by your editor, or by another tool's config), so expect to ignore a few with `#deadweight.ignore#`.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
